purpose: Compare missing constructive means, not select a familiar efficiency service. These are bounded discovery hypotheses, not inventions or an operating cohort.

possibilities.new_productive_activity: Recover actual previously unread words or works from crushed, contacting or torn closed-scroll regions where the strongest permitted full pipeline fails. Whole-scroll reading itself is already demonstrated.
possibilities.beneficiary: Collections, papyrologists and historical research; contingent funded prize organizer is a possible payer, not an admitted customer.
possibilities.missing_means: Construct a joint material-coordinate and ink inference instrument that preserves sheet identity across ambiguous contacts; require every letter signal to map back to the same CT-supported physical surface.
possibilities.origin: Model-proposed hypothesis; no beyond-human or exhaustive novelty finding.

structural_transfer.mapping: Local surface patches act as reads; fiber/joins supply long-range scaffolds; winding is an ordered material coordinate. Joint reconstruction must remain consistent with physical CT.
structural_transfer.failure: Repeated fibers and destroyed material can make correspondence non-identifiable. Language priors can hallucinate text. Official predecessors already propose several of these constraints.
structural_transfer.required_adaptation: A new, demonstrably useful constraint or coupling beyond the global spiral fitter must be identified before code is called an invention.

possibilities.strong_complete_alternative: Pinned villa8ff06f7620dcb663ed327028dbb8a0cf7e9a8198: VC3D/ScrollFiesta, global spiral, winding/fiber constraints and current 3D ink models; permitted manual repair and equal data/compute. Grand Prize excludes higher-resolution target-derived scans.

decisive_construction_and_test.first_gate: Find a hard region with rights-cleared paired CT, independently checked geometry and ink truth, and reproduce a meaningful complete-baseline failure. Then freeze a concrete additional coupling, baseline, held-out region, thresholds, budgets and independent checks.
decisive_construction_and_test.construction: Implement only that missing coupling in the existing pipeline; ablate the extra coupling with equal constraints and permitted tools. No new viewer or framework.
decisive_construction_and_test.measurement: Correct sheet correspondence AND CT-supported readable ink on held-out regions; external technical reproduction and independent letter-level reading for actual acceptance. A geometry score alone is insufficient.
decisive_construction_and_test.falsifier: Baseline or ordinary reuse already supplies the result, added coupling fails either outcome, or evidence cannot distinguish explanations. Ambiguous cases stay UNKNOWN.
decisive_construction_and_test.current_gap: Only0.806MB of real geometric annotation metadata inspected. No adequate paired confirmatory fixture or qualified full runtime identified within the remaining storage/time allocation. Partial public reads exist; this is a bounded search finding, not proof that no fixture exists.

economics.demand: Published contingent prizes and independent acceptance rules; no win or purchase contract.
economics.acceptance_obligations: Eligibility, permissive code/VC3D integration, held-out validation, <=8 documented annotation hours for Grand Prize, licensing and organizer review; discovery must remain unpublished until award. No finding or submission made here.
economics.conditional_frontier: For one mutually exclusive gross award A, acceptance probability p and expected fully charged cost E[C_all], including taxes and all delivery/terminal obligations, expected surplus is p*A-E[C_all]. Break-even requires p*A>E[C_all]. Both p and E[C_all] are unmeasured; no numerical viability interval or actual profit follows. Categories cannot be summed as earned revenue.
economics.value_capture: Only actual accepted award/contract can establish capture; open-source and noncommercial data terms constrain alternatives.
economics.cash_bridge: Collected receipts, capital recovery, liabilities and required reserves are unmeasured. Deposits, borrowing or reserve releases are not earned revenue; no unrestricted earned cash can finance a successor.

foresight.enabling_change: Current broad CT access, global reconstruction and cross-scroll ink tools may leave hard-material generalization as the next bottleneck. This is a scenario, not an outcome forecast.
foresight.adverse_scenario: Existing pipeline or competitors solve the target first; ambiguous CT lacks recoverable signal; award conditions or rights prevent capture.
foresight.resolution: A new unread-region recovery beats the matched complete baseline and is independently accepted; otherwise the claim fails or stays unresolved.

possibilities.successor: A fresh layered-archive/material reconstruction task, with retained coupling compared against no inheritance and ordinary equivalent-content reuse after full acquisition cost.

possibilities.new_productive_activity: One small construct usable for cross-species TfR1 delivery research by combining human binding atpH7.4, release atpH6.0 and mouse binding atpH7.4. Binding alone does not establish transport, therapy or safety.
possibilities.beneficiary: Drug-delivery researchers; an active challenge supplies a functional request but no purchase acceptance for ALPHA.
possibilities.missing_means: A physical small scaffold combining receptor-interface portability with state-dependent release.
possibilities.origin: Model-proposed constructive hypothesis; exact joint-function novelty not established.

structural_transfer.mapping: Require one design to satisfy functional states, rather than maximizing single-state affinity.
structural_transfer.failure: Conformation, expression, receptor geometry or protonation changes can break the other states; docking confidence cannot validate the conjunction.
structural_transfer.required_adaptation: A molecular mechanism must actually instantiate the switch and remain functional across species; a scoring-function change is not enough.

possibilities.strong_complete_alternative: Known pH-sensitive human antibodyF06, earlier mouse-TfR nanobody, human/mouse affibodies, expert molecular engineering and current generative pipelines including RFD4-Proteina plus experimental validation.

decisive_construction_and_test.first_gate: Check whether an existing eligible scaffold already meets the exact joint specification; retain it if so. Resolve the organizer passage that says four assay conditions while naming three, and obtain actual assay allocation and quote.
decisive_construction_and_test.construction: Freeze a small candidate panel with a concrete joint switching mechanism and strongest known/generative controls; express physical candidates.
decisive_construction_and_test.measurement: Measured joint human/mouse binding and acidic release with controls, specificity and expression failures included; then a separate cargo-transport test if transport is claimed.
decisive_construction_and_test.falsifier: Known eligible construct already supplies the complete result or any required physical function fails. No in-silico substitute.
decisive_construction_and_test.current_gap: No allocated GPU/model runtime or physical assays. Sponsorship does not guarantee open-track experimental allocation. No sequence constructed or submitted.

economics.demand: Externally specified research challenge; no cash prize and no ALPHA license or purchase price.
economics.price_scope: Different service configurations; none is a quote for the complete joint assay.
economics.conditional_frontier: Licensing/service revenue must exceed compute, every failed physical design, full joint assays, functional validation, IP and delivery obligations. Revenue and total cost are unknown. Sponsor validation credits are not earned income.
economics.value_capture: Unestablished; competition research value and lab subsidy do not imply commercial acceptance.
economics.cash_bridge: Collected receipts, capital recovery, liabilities and required reserves are unmeasured. Deposits, borrowing or reserve releases are not earned revenue; no unrestricted earned cash can finance a successor.

foresight.enabling_change: Recent joint sequence/structure generators could expand controllable molecular components; experimental multi-state function may become the binding constraint.
foresight.adverse_scenario: Current methods already supply the construct, or binding gains fail transport, specificity or expression.
foresight.resolution: An actual jointly functional physical component and separate accepted use, not predicted affinity.

possibilities.successor: Use a verified mechanism to construct a fresh functional delivery component under matched controls; transport and earned-funded construction remain separate tests.

possibilities.new_productive_activity: Execute a specified protected logical operation or workload on a newly discovered code under a fixed full hardware and error budget where competent architectures cannot meet the same requirement. A better memory code is insufficient.
possibilities.beneficiary: Fault-tolerant architecture researchers and hardware builders; buyer acceptance and a paid delivery route are missing.
possibilities.missing_means: A constructive code-to-operation mechanism providing explicit logical action, fault protection, routing and complete resources for a specific unsupported operation.
possibilities.origin: Model-proposed hypothesis. Generic code/circuit co-design, compilation and fault-tolerant instructions already exist.

structural_transfer.mapping: A code output must carry executable logical operations plus checkable logical-action and fault/resource obligations, rather than just parity matrices or an efficiency score.
structural_transfer.failure: A valid code or distance witness does not imply a useful operation; routing, ancillas, decoding latency and correlated faults can consume all gains.
structural_transfer.required_adaptation: Identify an operation/hardware combination not already handled by Tour de Gross, OmniQEC and current constructions, then construct and independently check the missing operation.

possibilities.strong_complete_alternative: Tour de Gross full logical instruction/compiler/resource architecture; OmniQEC code-circuit-decoder search with circuit-noise simulation, not hardware validation; conventional surface and bicycle architectures, current qcode-discovery and independent distance proofs.

decisive_construction_and_test.first_gate: Name a specific unsupported logical operation and freeze hardware connectivity, noise, logical task, total resources and baseline. No generic first-co-design claim survives the source comparison.
decisive_construction_and_test.construction: Produce code plus logical-operation circuit and explicit logical-action/fault obligations using a qualified execution environment; exact algebra/proofs and noise trials answer different questions.
decisive_construction_and_test.measurement: Independent logical-action checks plus circuit-noise/decoder evaluation and total spacetime resources against complete matched architectures. Distance lower-bound certification must not be inferred from an upper-bound witness.
decisive_construction_and_test.falsifier: Existing architecture satisfies the task equally well; operation invalid or full implementation cost removes the gain. Memory-only improvement does not pass.
decisive_construction_and_test.current_gap: No distinct unsupported operation selected; no qualified arbitrary generated-program sandbox, complete noise/resource benchmark or buyer contract. No new code or circuit executed.

economics.demand: Research and hardware need is evidenced; the current QEC leaderboard offers no cash award. A separate quantum-applications prize is not an accessible paid contract for a new code.
economics.conditional_frontier: Require independently evidenced service/license receipts or downstream contribution to exceed all search, proof, decoder, circuit/hardware validation and support costs. Qubit reduction alone is not profit.
economics.value_capture: No accepted service, license or funding allocation.
economics.cash_bridge: Collected receipts, capital recovery, liabilities and required reserves are unmeasured. Deposits, borrowing or reserve releases are not earned revenue; no unrestricted earned cash can finance a successor.

foresight.enabling_change: Rapid code discovery may shift the constraint from memory parameters to operations and full hardware realizability; current predecessors already partially address it.
foresight.adverse_scenario: Current code-operation designs dominate or hardware/timing costs overwhelm nominal code gains.
foresight.resolution: Actual operation meets a frozen complete workload budget and wins the matched test; this investigation has not supplied such a result.

possibilities.successor: A different logical operation/code/hardware construction with inherited obligations and equally available ordinary reuse, charged for acquisition and verification.
